suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin Gradle plugin build-cache metadata processing, not kotlin-stdlib runtime code. The NVD generic Kotlin CPE causes this runtime false positive. Mnemos disables Kotlin task build caching until a stable fixed Kotlin release is available. Remove this suppression after upgrading Kotlin.

CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin Gradle plugin build-cache metadata processing, not kotlin-reflect runtime code. The NVD generic Kotlin CPE causes this runtime false positive. Mnemos disables Kotlin task build caching until a stable fixed Kotlin release is available. Remove this suppression after upgrading Kotlin.

CVE-2026-66299 is confined to Tomcat's WebSocket chat example application. Mnemos uses embedded Tomcat and does not package or deploy Tomcat's examples web application, so the vulnerable unbounded example message buffer is absent. Remove this suppression after upgrading to Tomcat 11.0.25 or later.
